about_the_game:
Sanyin is a platform action music game. Under the Xuanhuan sky where the star rhythm has collapsed, use rhythm as a blade and dodge as a gap to rebuild the sound of the Heavenly Dao amid the glint of swords and shadows of blades.

Story Background

The Twenty-Eight Mansions transformed into pitchpipes to guard the eight directions, until the "Jiaosu Tianlü" (Celestial Rhythm of the Horn Mansion) shattered bizarrely. From the broken part of the Heavenly Dao's strings gushed the "Erosion Sound Miasma Curtain". Corrupted star officials are devouring the Three Realms with distorted sound waves, and the melody of all things is falling into irreversible collapse...

Current Features

Editor: Freely import audio/images/animations to build an exclusive rhythm battlefield

Workshop Integration: Share or experience player-created world levels

Online System: Supports local multiplayer and Steam online multiplayer

Difficulty Selection: Multiple difficulty levels to suit different players

Story Mode Demo: 3 prologue levels unlocked as early access to the full story mode

Upcoming Features

Full Story Mode: Over 20 main levels, more characters

More Gameplay: Diverse gameplay styles such as Endless Mode

More stable online methods

Help and Feedback: View the manual on the right →
